name: stz-stories-tools
description: Run npm install here before using the tools; nothing is installed by default. Tools for looking at and listening to a story without a browser. @napi-rs/canvas renders stills (check.mjs --stills, crop.mjs). tone and node-web-audio-api render the score offline (check.mjs --audio, sectiontest.mjs) with the same code the MP4 export runs. The stories themselves need nothing installed.
